[EN] I am the adjutant of Kaiator's glorious headquarters.
[ES] Soy el ayudante del glorioso cuartel general de Kaiator.

[EN] For Kaia's glory!
[ES] ¡Por la gloria de Kaia!

[EN] Yes, Deputy Commander! I sent soldiers to Darkquaver Woods as you instructed. We will hear from them soon.
[ES] ,¡Sí, subcomandante! Envié soldados a Darkquaver Woods tal como indicaste. Pronto sabremos de ellos.
